title: Embedding soft-launch contracts, scoring drift telemetry, and rollback safety net
creator: Aisha Raman
description: We need a repeatable, low-risk path to onboard new embedding models into the embeddings/reranking endpoint that protects production quality while allowing incremental traffic exposure. This ticket defines the "soft-launch contract" (service-level acceptance gates + metric thresholds), the scoring-drift telemetry surface to detect semantic regressions, and an automated rollback/safety-net that fails over to a pinned stable model without user-visible errors. The goal is to enable quick experiments with new open/quantized variants while keeping downstream reranking pipelines and customer SLAs stable.
acceptance_criteria: Soft-launch contract doc published in Confluence describing SLOs (p99 latency <= 120ms, avg vector cosine delta <= 0.015 on golden prompts) and required metrics for promotion to 100%
Telemetry pipeline emits daily scoring-drift and embedding-distribution reports to dashboards with alerts when drift exceeds thresholds
Canary router supports configurable 'soft traffic' rule (percent + session affinity) and a hard traffic limit that triggers automatic pin-and-fallback
Automatic rollback executes within 30s of an alert and routes all traffic to the stable model; rollback is logged and creates an incident ticket draft
End-to-end test harness that simulates quality regressions and verifies rollback behavior in staging is added to CI
tasks: Define soft-launch contract and promotion checklist (PM + Research review)
Instrument embeddings service to emit per-model metrics: cosine_distribution_hist, mean_cosine_vs_baseline, token_latency_p50_p95_p99
Add 'scoring-drift' Alert rule in PagerDuty / Ops alerts with action to trigger rollback playbook
Extend routing layer: implement percent-based soft traffic with session pinning and TTL
Implement rollback handler that updates routing config and writes structured audit event
Create Confluence runbook with verification steps and postmortem template
Ship small staging experiment with new compact-quant model and run 1-week soft launch
decisions: Use golden-prompt set maintained by Research instead of purely synthetic tests for scoring-drift checks
Soft-launch promotion requires both quality (cosine delta) and latency gates; failing either blocks promotion
Rollback will be automated but reversible; manual confirmation required before re-promotion
Telemetry stored in ClickHouse; daily aggregation queries will feed Grafana dashboards for long-term trend analysis
